what: Unity makes the game engine many mobile and independent games are built with, and runs an advertising network that helps those games find and monetise players. Advertising is the larger business.
customers: Game developers and studios, and advertisers buying placements inside mobile games.
money: in-game advertising network and monetisation tools
subscriptions and licences for the Unity engine
moat: The engine most mobile games are built in, which gives its advertising network data and integration no outside ad network has.
risks: It makes a significant operating loss
A disastrous pricing change in 2023 damaged developer trust
Revenue grew only about 2% last year
AppLovin has outperformed it badly in mobile advertising
opportunities: Its rebuilt advertising model has shown improving performance
Gross margin of 74% means a revenue recovery would turn into profit quickly
Cash of about $2.6 billion exceeds its debt
watch: Advertising revenue growth and whether developer subscriptions stabilise.
